# sqlite-graphrag (v1.2.8 LLM-Only One-Shot)

> Persistent memory for 27 AI agents in a single ~19 MiB Rust binary (LLM-only, one-shot)

27 AI agents. One ~19 MiB binary. Zero model download. sqlite-graphrag **v1.2.8** (current — crate `version = "1.2.8"`; the dead `pending` family removed, the top-level catalogue at 50 verbs and the schema catalogue at 76 contracts, the unfilled `fts_bm25` contract field removed, the orphan reaper rebuilt on `sysinfo` so macOS stops reporting zero without measuring, and a source-language gate; inherits v1.2.8 — the rustdoc link gate (GAP-SG-228) and the NDJSON surface fix (GAP-SG-229); remember input contract (GAP-SG-216) — the name may be positional or `--name`, a non-canonical `entity_type` is reported in `warnings` and refusable with `--strict-entity-types` on `remember` and `remember-batch`, `--dry-run` reports parsed graph sizes and every non-canonical label, and the `--graph-stdin` / `--graph-file` wire shape plus the dry-run envelope ship as the `graph-input` and `remember-dry-run` schemas; `--count-only` refused with exit 2 over a page a query ceiling cut, over a per-line stream, and suppressed after a write with no result array; `count_scope` reports `page`; `export` / `embedding list` declare their ceiling; NDJSON stream contract (GAP-SG-215) — record lines carry no `agent_surface`, the summary line carries the one record for the whole stream and is never reshaped, and every whole-set knob is refused before the first byte; agent-native output surface plus `--no-input`; open `entity_type` vocabulary (GAP-SG-277, GAP-SG-278) — any label is stored as written, the thirteen canonical kinds are recommended, `--strict-entity-types` restricts a write to them — via migration **V017**, so schema moves **v16 → v17**; enrich-queue **CAPA seal**: namespace claim isolation (`dequeue_next_pending` / `count_eligible_pending` require operation **and** namespace); `--until-empty` counts only this op+ns; `--force-redescribe` reopens `skipped`/`done` once/process; re-embed eligibility uses BLOB `LENGTH(embedding)=dim*4` + zombie reconcile; enqueue strips `entity:` prefix; chunk ns validate; CAPA-D compound configuration-file markers only; inherits v1.2.0 **DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_DIM=1024** + XDG map `db.default_path`→`db.path` + offline harness `scripts/e2e_offline_v120.sh` **20/20**; help scrub / no product env; `enrich --list-skipped` / `--requeue-skipped`; GAP-SG-139 `--db` no-op on host leaves; residual honesty: residual monólitos optional; live LQ backfill = operator campaign). Config precedence: **CLI flag > XDG `config set` > default**. Product `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_*` is **not** the config path. Embeddings via OpenRouter REST only; the headless `claude`/`codex`/`opencode` backends were removed in v1.2.0. Graph-native retrieval. Deterministic JSON for pipeline orchestration.

- Read this document in [Portuguese (pt-BR)](llms.pt-BR.txt).
- Architecture rationale: [ADR-0019](docs/decisions/adr-0019-llm-only-one-shot.md) (LLM-only one-shot), [ADR-0020](docs/decisions/adr-0020-pure-rust-cosine.md) (pure-Rust cosine), [ADR-0021](docs/decisions/adr-0021-deprecate-daemon.md) (daemon deprecated), [ADR-0022](docs/decisions/adr-0022-blob-embeddings.md) (BLOB-backed embeddings), [ADR-0023](docs/decisions/adr-0023-remove-tokenizers.md) (tokenizers removed), [ADR-0024](docs/decisions/adr-0024-fts5-coarse-cosine-refine.md) (FTS5 coarse + cosine refine), [ADR-0025](docs/decisions/adr-0025-oauth-only-embedding.md) (OAuth-only LLM), [ADR-0052](docs/decisions/adr-0052-openrouter-embedding-backend.md) (OpenRouter embedding backend)


## v1.2.7 Target Provenance + Range-Validated Reads (no schema migration)
- Crate **1.2.7**; schema stays at **v16**; pin `=1.2.7`
- Every side-effecting verb now publishes the provenance of its target in the envelope: `db_path_source` and `db_path_resolved`
- Thirteen numeric read arguments now carry a parse-time range; an out-of-range value is refused by clap with **exit 2** before any work runs
- Top-k (`-k`, `--k`, read `--limit`, `--max-results`): **1..=4096**
- `export --limit`, `pending-embeddings --limit`, `embedding --limit`: **1..=1000000** (**historical**: `pending --limit` sat in this list until the whole `pending` family was removed in v1.2.8; the binary now answers `unrecognized subcommand` with exit 2)
- `--max-hops` / `--hops` / `--depth`: **1..=64**
- `--max-sub-queries`: **1..=64**
- Rustdoc lints are denied through the manifest `[lints.rustdoc]` table

## v1.2.6 Agent-Native Output Surface Corrections (no schema migration)
- Crate **1.2.6**; schema stays at **v16**; pin `=1.2.6`
- `--filter` now evaluates the whole result set instead of the emitted page
- A key that does not exist in `--select` / `--filter` is now refused with **exit 2** instead of returning an empty payload with exit 0
- The result array is no longer fabricated when the envelope carries none
- A knob declared with no effect no longer returns exit 0

## v1.2.2 Agent-Native Output Surface (no schema migration)
- Crate **1.2.2**; schema stays at **v16**; pin `=1.2.2`
- Eight global flags reshape every subcommand envelope at one point: `--select`/`--fields`, `--filter`, `--max-items`, `--sort`, `--dedupe-by`, `--count-only`, `--truncate-content`, `--max-output-bytes`
- Fixed order: filter → sort → dedupe → max-items → select → count-only → truncate-content → max-output-bytes
- `--filter` grammar: `key=value`, `key!=value`, `key~substring`; `==` synonym of `=`; repeat to conjoin with AND; malformed expression exits **2**
- `--max-items` bounds emission only, after filtering — DISTINCT from per-subcommand `--limit` and from `-k`, which bound the query
- Failure envelopes (`error: true` / `ok: false`) are **never** filtered; `$schema` documents pass through untouched; NDJSON streams bypass the surface
- Truncation is never silent: recorded under `agent_surface`, raises top-level `truncated`; `--max-output-bytes` drops trailing elements, never slices JSON text
- `--no-input` refuses stdin declaratively — every stdin reader fails up front with **exit 1** (`AppError::Validation`; measured envelope `code: 1`); precedence flag > XDG `cli.no_input` > `false`
- `schema` subcommand — `sqlite-graphrag schema` lists ALL **76** contracts as NDJSON `{"id","invoke"}`, one per line; `sqlite-graphrag schema --name <ID>` emits that JSON Schema document; unknown `<ID>` exits **4**; `$schema` documents are exempt from the output surface, so any global flag chains safely
- **Historical** (the `claude-code` value went out with the subprocess backends; `ingest --mode` accepts only `none` and clap refuses anything else with exit 2) — `--mode claude-code` NDJSON unified with the standard pipeline (GAP-SG-148 item 5): per-file `status` is **`indexed`** not `done`; summary reports **`files_total`/`files_succeeded`/`files_failed`/`files_skipped`** not `completed`
- Precedence for caps: flag > XDG `agent_surface.max_items` / `agent_surface.truncate_content` / `agent_surface.max_output_bytes` > `0` (disabled)
- With no flag set the envelope is byte-for-byte identical to v1.2.1 output

## v1.2.1 CAPA Seal (enrich queue, no schema migration)
- Crate **1.2.1**; schema stays at **v16**; pin `=1.2.1`
- Namespace claim isolation: claim / count / resume filter by `operation` **and** `namespace`
- `--until-empty` counts pending for **this op+namespace only**
- `--force-redescribe` reopens `skipped`/`done` once per process (`reopen_force_redescribe_candidates`; never `dead`)
- Re-embed: eligibility via `LENGTH(embedding) = dim*4`; `reconcile_satisfied_reembed_pending` clears zombies
- Enqueue: strip `entity:` for lookup; validate chunk keys in target namespace; CAPA-D compound "configuration file" markers only
- Regressions: `enqueue_candidate_accepts_entity_prefixed_reembed_key`, `dequeue_next_pending_isolates_by_namespace`; queue suite 38 OK

## v1.2.0 Seal (XDG config, dim 1024, no schema migration)
- Crate **1.2.0**; schema stays at **v16**; pin `=1.2.0`; **DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_DIM=1024**
- Config: flag > XDG `config set` > default; product `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_*` is **not read** at runtime
- OpenRouter URLs from XDG; `search.hybrid.max_graph_results` caps the graph fan-out (default 50)
- EntityType fold `module`→Concept; `related_to`→`related`; remember-batch description required on create
- Aliases: `pending-embeddings status`, `cache stats`; `purge --now`; `config list --effective`
- Enrich recover: `enrich --list-skipped` / `enrich --requeue-skipped` (skipped / `preservation_failed` sink)
- GAP-SG-139: `--db` is a documented **no-op** on host/XDG leaves (`config`, `slots`, `cache`, `completions`)
- Telemetry lib alias removed; offline harness `scripts/e2e_offline_v120.sh` **20/20**
- Residual honest: GAP-SG-89 LOC≤800 largely closed; residual monólitos optional; live LQ backfill is an operator campaign

## v1.0.85 Architecture (LLM-Only, supersedes v1.0.79)
- The default build is LLM-only and one-shot. There is no daemon, no ONNX runtime, no `libonnxruntime.so` to ship, and no `multilingual-e5-small` model to download. Embedding is a REST call to OpenRouter; nothing local holds a model.
- Embedding generation: one OpenRouter REST request per call. The CLI never holds an embedding model in memory.
- Vector search: cosine similarity is computed in pure Rust over the BLOB embeddings stored in `memory_embeddings`, `entity_embeddings`, and `chunk_embeddings`. The `sqlite-vec` extension is gone.
- Daemon: deprecated in v1.0.76 and FULLY REMOVED in v1.0.79 (ahead of the v1.1.0 schedule). The CLI is 100% one-shot with zero IPC.
- `embedding-legacy`, `ner-legacy` and `full` features: REMOVED in v1.0.79 (ahead of the v1.1.0 schedule) together with the optional fastembed/ort/ndarray/tokenizers/hf-hub dependencies. Every build is LLM-only.
- Embedding pipeline (G42, v1.0.79): default dimensionality 1024 (`--embedding-dim` / XDG `embedding.dim`, range [8, 4096]; precedence flag > XDG > `schema_meta.dim` > 1024; historical G42 defaults 64/384 retired); batched calls (calibration bases of 8 chunks / 25 entity names at dim 64, adapted as clamp(base×64/dim, 1, base) — G44); bounded parallelism via `--llm-parallelism` on `remember` (default 4), `ingest` (default 2) and `edit`; every subprocess uses `kill_on_drop` plus `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBED_TIMEOUT_SECS` (default 300s).
- Canonical re-embed: `enrich --operation re-embed --limit N --resume` (v1.1.01 adds `--target memories|entities|chunks|all`, default `memories`); single-memory re-embed via `edit --force-reembed`.
- Migration from v1.0.74/v1.0.75: `sqlite-graphrag migrate --to-llm-only --drop-vec-tables --db <path>` is the one-shot upgrade. Combines checksum rewrite (--rehash) with V013 vec-table drop. The BLOB-backed embedding tables stay empty until the next `remember` / `edit` / `ingest` re-embeds via the LLM.


## v1.0.86 → v1.0.91 Architecture (Pre-flight, Schema Drift, Flag Parity, OpenCode Backend, Spawn Isolation)
- v1.0.86 added 10 LLM-pipeline subcommands: `pending list|show|cleanup`, `embedding status|list|abandon`, `pending-embeddings list|process`, `slots status|release`. New global flags: `--max-concurrency`, `--wait-lock`, `--llm-parallelism`, `--ingest-parallelism`, --graceful-shutdown-secs (**historical**: the v1.2.8 parser does not define it), `--skip-embedding-on-failure`. Host-wide slot semaphore via `fs4` with `fcntl(F_SETLK)` on Unix and `LockFileEx` on Windows (ADR-0036, 0037, 0038, 0039, 0040)
- v1.0.87 added the pre-flight validation layer: `src/spawn/preflight.rs` (≥200 lines, 7 guards, 15 unit tests) gates every LLM subprocess spawn BEFORE the fork. New `AppError::PreFlightFailed(PreFlightError)` with `exit_code() == 16` (`EX_CONFIG`, `is_permanent() == true`) — **historical only**: `PreFlightFailed` has zero occurrences in `src/` today and there is no exit 16; `exit_code()` in `src/errors.rs` maps to 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 14 and 20, beside clap's 2 and the slot-lock 75. The 7 guards in order: `check_argv_size`, `check_binary_exists`, `check_mcp_config_inline`, `check_mcp_config_path`, `check_walkup_mcp_json`, `check_output_buffer`, `check_claude_config_dir`. Bypass via `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_SKIP_PREFLIGHT=1` (ADR-0045, GAP-META-005). **Historical**: the pre-flight layer and that variable were **removed** in v1.2.0 together with the headless subprocess backends; no flag or XDG key replaces them
- v1.0.88 hotfixes: BUG-11 (CRITICAL) preflight failure in `extract/llm_embedding.rs:563-565` now propagates to `remember` via `embed_via_backend_strict`; BUG-12 (MEDIUM) OAuth-only enforcement emits 1 stderr line (was 2); BUG-13 (MEDIUM) `link --create-missing` respects entity-name validation. 11 new regression tests (ADR-0046, ADR-0047)
- v1.0.89 schema drift + flag parity: `health.schema.json` regenerated via `schemars` derive macro (Must-Ignore policy per RFC 7493 I-JSON, `additionalProperties: true`); 17 new fields added. 5 subcommands now accept `--db <PATH>`: `embedding status|list|abandon`, `pending list|show`. `migrate --dry-run --json` reports pending migrations without applying. `codex-models --json` accepted as no-op (**historical**: the subcommand does not exist in v1.2.8 — the binary answers `unrecognized subcommand` with exit 2). `ingest --auto-describe` (default true) extracts description from first meaningful body line. `health --namespace <NS> --json` filters counts. Binary size 14.6 MiB documented in `Cargo.toml:6` (ADR-0048, ADR-0049)
- v1.0.90 OpenCode backend integration (ADR-0051): third LLM backend `opencode run` alongside `codex exec` and `claude -p`. New `--llm-backend opencode`, `--mode opencode` for ingest/enrich, `--opencode-binary/model/timeout` flags and `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_OPENCODE_*` variables (**historical**: backend and variables **removed** in v1.2.0). Fallback chain extended to `codex → claude → opencode → none`. 24-bug remediation including `--skip-embedding-on-failure` activation, `--llm-fallback` dead-flag fix, FTS desync in batch/enrich, Windows cross-compilation, embedding timeout hardcode, `list` pagination, `--yes` enforcement on destructive commands
- v1.0.91 spawn CWD isolation: `spawn_isolation_dir()` and `apply_cwd_isolation()` in `src/spawn/mod.rs` set `current_dir` to an ephemeral temp directory and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` to the same dir for ALL 10 production spawn sites. LLM subprocesses no longer inherit `.mcp.json` from the caller's project — embedding works zero-config in any directory. `cleanup_spawn_dir()` removes the temp dir at process exit. BUG-17 fixed `entities.degree` inflation: `increment_degree()` replaced by `recalculate_degree()` after all relationships are inserted. BUG-15/16 fixed 8 JSON schemas with missing enum values and fields


## v1.0.93 Architecture (OpenRouter Embedding Backend)
- v1.0.93 adds optional OpenRouter REST API embedding backend via the `--embedding-backend` global flag (ADR-0052, GAP-OR-INGEST). It shipped as `auto|openrouter|llm`; the `llm` value is **historical** and went out with the subprocess backends in v1.2.0, so the binary accepts only `auto` and `openrouter`
- `EmbeddingBackendChoice` enum (`Auto`, `Openrouter`, `Llm`) is separate from `LlmBackendChoice` — embedding and LLM extraction are independent selections
- `--embedding-model MODEL` selects the OpenRouter model; NO default — user MUST specify when using `--embedding-backend openrouter`
- API key: CLI flag `--openrouter-api-key` or XDG `config add-key openrouter` (G-T-XDG-04: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is ignored at runtime; handled via `secrecy::SecretString` with zeroize-on-drop, NEVER logged)
- Direct REST API via `reqwest+rustls-tls` to `POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings` — ~100-500ms vs 20-60s subprocess LLM cold-start
- MRL (Matryoshka Representation Learning) truncation to configured `--embedding-dim` (default 1024)
- 10 verified models: `qwen/qwen3-embedding-4b`, `qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b`, `nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2:free`, `openai/text-embedding-3-small`, `openai/text-embedding-3-large`, `perplexity/pplx-embed-v1-0.6b`, `mistralai/mistral-embed-2312`, `baai/bge-m3`, `google/gemini-embedding-001`, `google/gemini-embedding-2`
- `EmbeddingBackendChoice` propagated to ALL 8 embedding commands: `remember`, `remember-batch`, `ingest`, `recall`, `edit`, `restore`, `hybrid-search`, `deep-research`
- `--enrich-after` flag on `ingest` triggers `enrich --operation memory-bindings` sequentially after all files are ingested
- BUG-OR-1 through BUG-OR-5: input_type per model, MRL detection, model validation, HTTP 200 malformed retry, dimension override

## Core Commands
### Subcommands grouped by lifecycle
- `init` initializes the SQLite database. No model download.
- `remember` saves a memory with name, type, description, body and optional entity graph; spawning an LLM subprocess per call for embedding generation
- `ingest` bulk-ingests files under a directory as separate memories (`--mode none`; NDJSON progress)
- `recall` performs pure-Rust cosine KNN similarity search over stored BLOB embeddings
- `hybrid-search` fuses FTS5 full-text and pure-Rust cosine KNN via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
- `deep-research` decomposes a query into up to 7 sub-queries (single-token queries expand to multi-aspect sub-queries with `source: "aspect"`, EN/PT facets; manual via `--sub-query-strategy manual --sub-queries-file`, v1.1.05), computes a separate embedding per sub-query, runs parallel vector+FTS hybrid search fused via RRF plus 3-hop graph traversal per sub-query, deduplicates and assembles directed evidence chains; `--output PATH` writes the full envelope via atomwrite and emits a short stdout ack with `blake3`; pair with global `--quiet`/`-q`
- `read` `list` `forget` `rename` `edit` `history` `restore` manage the memory lifecycle
- `remember-batch` ingests multiple memories from a NDJSON stream in a single invocation
- `export` dumps memories as NDJSON (one JSON line per memory, plus a summary line); filter by `--namespace` / `--type`
- `completions` generates shell completion scripts for bash, zsh, fish, elvish and powershell
- `schema` lists every shipped JSON Schema as NDJSON, one `{id, invoke}` object per line (**76** contracts, `invoke` being the ready-to-copy command); `schema --name <ID>` emits that contract document and an unknown `<ID>` exits **4**. This is the canonical self-discovery surface for an agent
- `link` `unlink` `related` manage typed entity relationships for multi-hop traversal; `link --from-id`/`--to-id` (v1.1.05) resolve by ID; pure digit names are rejected so `--create-missing` cannot create ghost numeric entities; `graph traverse --fuzzy` (v1.1.05) auto-resolves clear short-name winners and NotFound suggests ranked canonical names without `--fuzzy`
- `health` `stats` `migrate` `vacuum` `optimize` `sync-safe-copy` manage the database
- `migrate --rehash` rewrites recorded migration checksums to match the current file content (one-shot fix for v1.0.74 → v1.0.76 V002 mismatch)
- `migrate --to-llm-only --drop-vec-tables` one-shot upgrade for v1.0.74/v1.0.75 databases: rehash + apply V013 + report vec-table state
- `backup` creates a consistent database backup using SQLite Online Backup API, safe with WAL mode
- `fts rebuild` `fts check` `fts stats` repair, verify, and inspect the FTS5 full-text index
- `vec orphan-list` `vec purge-orphan` `vec stats` maintain BLOB vector tables (orphan detection / purge)
- `memory-entities` lists all entities linked to a named memory
- `delete-entity` removes an entity and optionally cascades to its relationships
- `rename-entity` renames a graph entity preserving all FK-based relationships and re-embeds for vector search; `--id <id>` (v1.1.01) selects by ID for namespace-scoped disambiguation
- `reclassify` changes the `entity_type` of one entity or a whole category via `--batch`
- `merge-entities` merges duplicate entity nodes into a single canonical node; `--ids <csv>`/`--into-id <id>` (v1.1.01) select by ID when duplicated names across namespaces block name-based merges; `--cross-namespace` (v1.1.03, opt-in, default same-namespace) lets `--ids`/`--into-id` resolve across all namespaces; self-referential merges (`--into-id` in `--ids`, or `--into` in `--names`) are rejected BEFORE any DB work (v1.1.05)
- `prune-ner` removes NER-generated bindings from one entity (`--entity`) or all (`--all --yes`)
- `remember --dry-run` previews parsing and graph extraction without writing to the database or spawning the LLM
- `cleanup-orphans` `prune-relations` remove orphaned entities and weak or unused relations from the graph
- `purge` (`--now` = `--retention-days 0`) and `namespace-detect` handle maintenance and namespace resolution
- `embedding` `pending-embeddings` inspect the pending-embedding queue (`pending-embeddings status` aliases `embedding status`); **historical**: the `pending` family inspected the remember-checkpoint queue until v1.2.8 removed it, and the binary now answers `unrecognized subcommand` with exit 2
- `slots` inspect/release the host-wide LLM slot semaphore; `cache list|stats|clear-models` manage XDG model cache (`stats` aliases `list`)
- `config set|get|list|unset|list --effective|doctor|path|add-key` manage XDG config (GAP-SG-139: `--db` no-op on `config`/`slots`/`cache`/`completions`)
- `reclassify-relation` renames relationship types across the graph; `--literal-from` (v1.1.01) matches the stored relation verbatim (no normalization) so legacy hyphenated edges migrate; `--literal-to <RELATION>` (v1.1.03) writes the target verbatim, so `--literal-from applies_to --literal-to applies-to --batch` migrates legacy underscore edges to canonical hyphen form
- `normalize-entities` normalizes all entity names in the namespace to lowercase kebab-case ASCII
- `graph recompute-degree` (v1.1.01) reconciles the cached `entities.degree` with the real edge counts in one transaction, per namespace or all; `--dry-run` previews, envelope `{total, updated, zeroed, unchanged}`
- `graph entity-types` (v1.2.8) reports the entity-type vocabulary the database actually holds — `{types[{type, count, canonical}], total_types, total_entities, namespace, elapsed_ms}`, most frequent first; `--namespace` scopes, `--format text` prints a compact summary. Since the vocabulary is open, the stored labels are no longer knowable from the source, so this is the only way to find one before filtering with `graph entities --entity-type`
- `split-body` (v1.1.03) divides memories whose body exceeds 25 000 characters into daughter memories at chunk boundaries, marks the original superseded, and creates canonical `replaces` relations from each daughter to the original; daughters are NOT embedded inline — run `enrich --operation re-embed --target memories` afterwards
- `enrich` LLM-augmented graph quality pipeline via `--mode openrouter` (the only accepted value; requires `--openrouter-model`); FULLY-IMPLEMENTED ops: `memory-bindings`, `entity-descriptions`, `body-enrich`, `re-embed` (`--target memories|entities|chunks|all`), `augment-bindings` (requires `--names`), `body-extract` (+ `--body-extract-graph-only`), `entity-connect` (**v1.1.06**: O(k) co-occurrence+hub×island scan, keys `pair:{id1}:{id2}` / `item_type=entity_pair`, drain by PK, first-scan `InterruptHandle` → Timeout exit **1** ≠ 75, NDJSON `scan_start`/`scan_meta`, GAP-002 `entity_connect_seen` preserved), `cross-domain-bridges` (same O(k) path); inspectors `--list-skipped` / `--requeue-skipped` (v1.2.0), `--list-dead` / `--requeue-dead`, `--reset-stale-claims` / `--stale-claim-secs <N>` (v1.1.03); **v1.2.1 CAPA:** namespace claim isolation, `--until-empty` op+ns count, `--force-redescribe` reopen skipped/done, re-embed BLOB `LENGTH(embedding)=dim*4` + zombie reconcile, `entity:` strip, chunk ns validate, CAPA-D configuration-file markers; NDJSON phases/items/summary; suite `tests/v1106_entity_connect_scan_regression.rs`; ADR-0066


## Configuration (XDG — v1.2.0)
### Runtime configuration surface (no product env)
- Precedence: **CLI flag > XDG `config set` > named default**
- Product env `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_*` is **not** read at runtime (forbidden for product knobs)
- Commands: `config set|get|list|unset`, `config list --effective`, `config doctor`, `config path`, `config add-key`
- Key keys: `network.openrouter.chat_url` / `network.openrouter.embeddings_url` (aliases `network.chat_url`, `network.embed_url`), `llm.probe_timeout_ms`, `embedding.dim`, `log.level`, `display.tz`, `enrich.*`
- DB path: `--db <PATH>` after the subcommand (default `./graphrag.sqlite`); XDG key `db.path` (legacy alias `db.default_path` maps to `db.path`)
- Secrets: `config add-key --provider openrouter` (stdin) or `--openrouter-api-key` (not product env tables)
- Allowed OS env: locale (`LANG`/`LC_*`), `PATH`, `HOME`/`USERPROFILE`, XDG base dirs, `NO_COLOR`, plus subprocess OAuth whitelist (`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, …) — never raw `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY`
- v1.2.0 seal: DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_DIM=1024; harness `scripts/e2e_offline_v120.sh` **20/20**; help scrub; fail-fast Auto query embed; EntityType `module`→Concept; remember-batch description required; `pending-embeddings status` / `cache stats`; `purge --now`; `related_to`→`related`; `enrich --list-skipped` / `--requeue-skipped`; GAP-SG-139 `--db` no-op on host leaves


## Graph Input
### Minimal payload contract for `remember`
- `--entities-file` expects a JSON array of entity objects
- Each entity must include `name` plus `entity_type` or alias `type`
- Recommended `entity_type` values: `project`, `tool`, `person`, `file`, `concept`, `incident`, `decision`, `memory`, `dashboard`, `issue_tracker`, `organization`, `location`, `date`
- Since v1.2.8 the vocabulary is OPEN: any other term is accepted and stored as written, reported in the response `warnings`, and refused with exit 1 only under `--strict-entity-types`
- `--relationships-file` expects a JSON array of relationship objects
- Each relationship must include `source`/`from`, `target`/`to`, `relation`, and `strength`
- `strength` must be a float in `[0.0, 1.0]` and maps to `weight` in graph outputs
- File payload relations use underscore labels like `applies_to`, `depends_on`, and `tracked_in`; dashed aliases are normalized before storage
- CLI flags on `link` and `unlink` use dashed labels like `applies-to`, `depends-on`, and `tracked-in`


## Automatic Extraction
### URL-regex extraction (GLiNER removed in v1.0.79)
- Pass `--enable-ner` to activate on `remember` and `ingest` (product env not read at runtime in v1.2.0)
- Since v1.0.79 this runs URL-regex extraction ONLY — the GLiNER zero-shot pipeline was removed with the `ner-legacy` feature
- **Historical**: the flag --gliner-variant (written without a code span here because the parser no longer defines it) was accepted as a no-op until v1.1.02 **removed** it; clap REJECTS it today with exit 2. `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_GLINER_MODEL` and `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_GLINER_THRESHOLD` are historical too and are **not** read at runtime
- Response field `extraction_method`: `url-regex`, `regex-only`, or `none:extraction-failed`
- For LLM-curated extraction run a SEPARATE `enrich --mode openrouter` pass; for exact control use `--graph-stdin`
- `--skip-extraction` is deprecated since v1.0.45 and has no effect
- `--max-rss-mb <MiB>` on `remember` and `ingest` aborts embedding when process RSS exceeds the threshold (default 8192 MiB)

## Ingest Mode
### The only extraction mode for bulk ingestion
- `--mode none` is the default AND the only accepted value; clap rejects anything else with exit 2
- Entity and relationship extraction is a SEPARATE step: run `enrich` as its own process after `ingest` exits 0, never chained with `&&`
- Budget control via `--max-cost-usd <N>` to limit cumulative API spend
- Deduplication via `--force-merge`, which matches on `body_hash`
- Description inference via `--auto-describe` (default) or `--no-auto-describe`
- Name scoping via `--name-prefix <PREFIX>`; file selection via `--pattern`, `--recursive`, `--max-files`
- Parallelism via `--ingest-parallelism <N>`; embedding fan-out via `--llm-parallelism <N>` after the verb
- Output is NDJSON: per-file events followed by a summary

## Exit Codes
### Deterministic status for pipeline routing
- `0` success: continue the agent loop
- `1` validation or runtime failure: log and surface to operator
- `2` invalid CLI argument: fix usage then retry
- `9` duplicate memory detected: skip or use `--force-merge`
- `3` optimistic update conflict: re-read `updated_at` and retry
- `4` memory or entity not found: handle missing resource gracefully
- `5` namespace could not be resolved: pass `--namespace` explicitly
- `6` payload exceeded configured limits: split body into smaller chunks
- `10` SQLite database error: run `health` to inspect integrity
- `11` embedding generation failed: check LLM CLI availability and retry
- `13` batch partial failure: honor backoff and retry later
- `14` filesystem I/O error: cache directory not writable, nonexistent ingest target directory
- `15` database busy after retries: wait and retry
- `19` SHUTDOWN: graceful shutdown interrupted work, partial state discarded, RETRY REQUIRED
- `20` internal or JSON serialization error
- `75` EX_TEMPFAIL: all concurrency slots busy OR job singleton locked, retry with backoff
- `77` available RAM below minimum required for LLM subprocess


## What Changed in v1.0.79
### G42: fast, parallel, robust LLM embedding pipeline
- Configurable embedding dimensionality, default **1024** (`--embedding-dim` / XDG `embedding.dim`; precedence flag > XDG > `schema_meta.dim` > 1024; existing 384-dim databases keep working via recorded dim; ZERO schema change)
- Batched LLM calls: calibration bases of 8 chunks / 25 entity names at dim 64, adapted as clamp(base×64/dim, 1, base) per call (`{items:[{i,v}]}` schema, G44) — 39 spawns collapse into 4-5
- Bounded parallelism (`Semaphore` + `JoinSet`): new `--llm-parallelism` on `remember` (default 4), `ingest` (default 2), `edit`; permits clamp [1, 32]
- **Historical** (v1.0.79 to v1.1.x, **removed** in v1.2.0 with the subprocess backends): `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_CLAUDE_EMBED_MODEL` and `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_EMBED_TIMEOUT_SECS` overrides plus `kill_on_drop` on every LLM subprocess; today the per-request budget is the global `--openrouter-timeout` flag or the XDG key `embedding.timeout_secs`
- Empty `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` by default on the embedding path (~40-50s → ~10-15s per call)
- Panic-free signal handler: second signal exits 130 with zero I/O; SIGPIPE exits 141
- Canonical re-embed: `enrich --operation re-embed --limit N --resume` plus `edit --force-reembed`; v1.1.01 adds `--target memories|entities|chunks|all` for entity/chunk backfill
- `validate_dim` errors on divergent vectors instead of silently truncating/padding
- REMOVED: daemon infrastructure; `embedding-legacy`/`ner-legacy`/`full` features and fastembed/ort/ndarray/tokenizers/hf-hub optional deps

## What Changed in v1.0.68
### Critical fixes (G28 + G29)
- v1.0.68 is the first release since v1.0.65 that compiles on Windows via `cargo install`.  v1.0.66 and v1.0.67 broke with `error[E0308]` in `src/terminal.rs:29` because `HANDLE` in `windows-sys >= 0.59` is `*mut c_void` (was `isize` in 0.48/0.52).  Fix: `!handle.is_null() && handle != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE` plus `windows-sys` pinned to `=0.59.0` exact, plus CI job `windows-build-check`.
- (**historical**, v1.0.68 — `ingest --mode` accepts only `none` since v1.2.0, and clap refuses `claude-code` / `codex` with exit 2) `enrich`, `ingest --mode claude-code`, and `ingest --mode codex` acquire a per-namespace singleton via `lock::acquire_job_singleton(job_type, namespace, wait_seconds)`.  A second concurrent invocation on the same database returns `AppError::JobSingletonLocked { job_type, namespace }` (exit 75, retryable) instead of stacking 4 × N workers × 10 MCP servers.
- `claude_runner::build_claude_command` now respects `SQLITE_GRAPHRAG_CLAUDE_EMPTY_CONFIG_DIR` (opt-in).  When set to an empty directory, the subprocess is spawned with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<that dir>`, suppressing user-scoped MCP servers.  This is the only mechanism Claude Code actually honours — `--strict-mcp-config` and `--mcp-config '{}'` are silently ignored per [anthropics/claude-code#10787].
- `enrich` emits a `tracing::warn!` when `--llm-parallelism > 4`, recommending the combination with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` override.
- `retry::CircuitBreaker` helper added with `AttemptOutcome::{Success, Transient, HardFailure}`.  Rate-limited and timeout errors are explicitly excluded from the failure count.
- 3 pre-existing test failures in `src/commands/{history,list,read}.rs` fixed (timezone-agnostic assertions).

## Stable Facts
### Identity and version metadata
- Package name `sqlite-graphrag` published on crates.io under MIT OR Apache-2.0
- Current version **1.2.8** (crate `1.2.8`; schema **v17** since migration **V017**; MSRV Rust **1.88**; binary ~19 MiB). Per-release detail lives in `CHANGELOG.md`; this file does not keep a second copy of it.
- Repository `https://github.com/danilo-aguiar-br/sqlite-graphrag` without GitHub Actions CI (releases published manually)
- Embedding model: OpenRouter REST API only (`qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b`, ~100-500ms per call). The headless `claude code` / `codex` / `opencode` subprocess backends were REMOVED in v1.2.0; nothing local holds a model.
- Storage layer: `rusqlite` with bundled SQLite and FTS5 module. `sqlite-vec` extension REMOVED in v1.0.76; vector similarity is pure-Rust cosine over BLOB embeddings
- Up to **16** concurrent instances by default via counting semaphore with `fs4` advisory locks (`MAX_CONCURRENT_CLI_INSTANCES = 16` in `src/constants/runtime.rs:42`; the rigid 4-slot ceiling went out in v1.0.75). Override per invocation with `--max-concurrency N`, capped at 2×nCPUs
- Official agent catalogue: **27** AI agents and IDEs supported out of the box (README section); crate description matches this count
### Schema and storage
- Current main-database schema version is **17** (`CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION` in `src/constants/storage.rs:64`), raised by migration **V017** in v1.2.8, which opened the `entity_type` vocabulary; v1.2.2 / v1.2.1 / v1.2.0 / v1.1.06 do **not** add a migration
- Schema v16 introduced in v1.1.04 via migration V016: table `entity_connect_seen(source_id, target_id, namespace, verdict, relation, evaluated_at)` with composite PK, dual `ON DELETE CASCADE` FKs to `entities(id)`, verdict CHECK, namespace index
- Embeddings stored as BLOB in `memory_embeddings` / `entity_embeddings` / `chunk_embeddings`; cosine is pure Rust; default dim **1024** (MRL truncation supported; legacy DBs keep `schema_meta.dim`)
- Enrich queue lives in sidecar `.enrich-queue.sqlite` next to the main DB (dead-letter `dead`, `error_class`, `next_retry_at`, `claimed_at`)
### Exit codes (operator-critical)
- `0` success; `1` validation **or** wall-clock Timeout (including first-scan entity-connect `InterruptHandle`); `2` CLI args; `3` optimistic lock; `4` not found (may include suggestions); `6` payload too large; `11` embedding failure; `15` SQLITE_BUSY; `19` SHUTDOWN (retry required); `75` job singleton / slot lock (**not** scan timeout). There is **no exit 78**: a missing OpenRouter key or model resolves to `1`. The full map of `exit_code()` in `src/errors.rs` is 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 14 and 20, beside clap's 2 and the slot-lock 75
- NEVER treat entity-connect first-scan Timeout as exit `75`
### Enrich entity-connect (v1.1.06 contract)
- Queue keys `pair:{id1}:{id2}` with `item_type=entity_pair`; drain by primary key without re-scan
- Pair candidates: co-occurrence in `memory_entities` + hub × degree-0 island fill (O(k); never cartesian O(n²))
- NDJSON: `scan_start` **before** SQL with real `operation` (`entity-connect` or `cross-domain-bridges`), `entities_in_namespace`, `backlog_degree0_proxy`; `scan_meta` with `pairs_enqueued_this_scan` / `scan_elapsed_ms` — do **not** equate the two backlog fields
- First scan covered by `--max-runtime` and soft 120s ceiling via `InterruptHandle` → Timeout exit **1**
- `cross-domain-bridges` shares the same O(k) scan + `entity_connect_seen` drain path; GAP-002 convergence preserved
- Suite: `tests/v1106_entity_connect_scan_regression.rs`; ADR-0066; pin library consumers `=1.2.8`
### Concurrency and credentials
- Per-namespace job singleton on `enrich` / LLM ingest modes → exit `75` under contention
- OAuth-only for `claude` / `codex` subprocesses: raw `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` ABORT spawn (exit 1)
- OpenRouter uses `config add-key` / `--openrouter-api-key` (REST embedding and chat enrich); product never reads `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`; never log the key
### Retrieval defaults
- Hybrid retrieval: FTS5 BM25 + BLOB cosine KNN fused with RRF; multi-hop via `graph traverse` / `related` / `deep-research`
- Single-token `deep-research` fans out to aspect sub-queries (`source: "aspect"`) since v1.1.05; large envelopes use `--output` atomwrite + `--quiet`
